children: the pricing of its public offering of $400M 5.650% senior unsecured notes due 2036.
Shares were 0.03% higher at $68.16 after market close.
The public offering price was 98.497% of the principal amount for an effective yield to maturity of 5.849%.
The offering is expected to close on September 22.
Net proceeds are intended to be used for general corporate purposes, including to reduce outstanding indebtedness and fund property acquisitions and development activity.
"This offering further increases our liquidity position to over $2B," said CFO Peter Coughenour.
